name: layered_heart
clip: reference_layered_heart.mp4 (480x640, 15 fps, 14.0 s; not in refclips/, read from targets.REF); reference frame 11.8 s; scene cut to an outro at 12.27 s
time_base: clip time. The clip contains two FREEZE FRAMES (see 'freezes'); real pour time = clip time - 1.133 s (t >= 1.2) - 1.333 s (t >= 6.6). The freeze at 5.20-6.53 s is encoded as a zero-flow hold stage; video_targets/layered_heart/stages_realtime.json is the same script with it cut out.
freezes: frames 79-98 duplicate frame 78 (instructor dashed guide line)
method: Stream foot read on native-resolution camera crops with a pixel grid (tiles/pix_*.png) and on rectified M-frame tiles with a 0.05 D grid (tiles/zoomM_*.png, the stream column projects as a strip toward the upper-left in M, the foot is its lower-right end), mapped with video_extract.image_to_cup on frames.npz track_ell (rot -130 deg, y_M = -y_T). Ellipse quality is 0/1 until 4.4 s (cup tilted toward the pitcher, near part of the surface hidden by the near rim): for t < 4.4 s a hand-fitted liquid ellipse is used instead (fixed a,b,phi = 112.5, 86 px, -3.0 rad; centre (220,318) until 1.2 s -> (218,320) 1.8 s -> (215,322) 2.4 s -> (213,325) 3.0 s -> (212,327) 3.6 s -> (212,328) 4.0 s -> track at 4.4 s; tiles/ellcheck_tilt_v1.png); the propagated track there is off by ~0.25 D. Wiggle frequency and amplitude from the lateral position of the stream 18-26 px above the foot at 15 fps. Heights from the vertical image extent of the stream minus its forward travel (camera elevation ~50 deg from b/a = 0.76, 28-31 px/cm), +-50 %. Flows from the stream width at the foot (13-18 px during the pour, 8-10 px at 10.1-10.3 s, 5-6 px at 10.6 s) with v = sqrt(v0^2 + 2 g z), +-40 %.

landmarks_M.note: instructor dots in the frozen frame 0 (tilted cup, hand-fit ellipse, +-0.07 D); the dashed guide line of the second freeze runs from (-0.46,0.07) to (0.38,0.22) (track ellipse, q2): +10 deg from x_M, i.e. across the pattern axis (the wiggle direction / the semicircle's diameter). Final heart: lobes and notch at +y_M (notch ~(0,0.15)), tip (0,-0.33), stem to (-0.01,-0.43).

tilt_phase_liquid_ellipses.note: hand-fitted liquid-surface ellipses (cx, cy, a, b, phi) [px, rad], targets.py axis convention, used for the positions at t < 4.4 s (linear in time between the keys; from 4.4 s frames.npz track_ell). frames.npz itself uses the propagated track in these frames (quality 0/1), which is offset by ~0.25 D (e.g. its first-white centroid_M (0.14,-0.25) vs the foot (-0.09,0.08) here), so frames.npz white maps before ~4 s are NOT in the same cup frame as these stage positions.

stages.note: 在B点注入流量. FREEZE FRAME: clip frames 0-17 are one still image (frame 0) with the B/C/D overlay, so this stage stands in for the unknown real pre-roll (the stream already lands at B in frame 0, surface uniformly brown). Foot under the B dot, camera px (238,283); cup tilted ~20 deg toward the pitcher, ellipse quality 0: position from a hand-fitted liquid ellipse (cx,cy)=(220,318), a,b=112.5,86 px (the near ~35 % of the surface is hidden by the near rim), +-0.07 D. Spout ~2-2.5 cm above the surface (vertical stream extent ~43 px), thick stream (~0.06 D).

video resumes at frame 18 (1.2 s): the stream foot slides ~20 px down-left in the image (toward D) in 0.3 s while the first white appears as a pale bulb at the foot (1.27 s, 0.04 D) that opens into a crescent by 1.47 s (feet: 1.20 (-0.12,0.14), 1.27 (-0.11,0.12), 1.33 (-0.10,0.08), 1.40 (-0.09,0.055)). Cup still tilted (hand-fit ellipse). Stream width at the foot ~12 px.

看到白色的线条出现后开始摆动 (subtitle from 1.47 s): lateral wiggle starts ~1.5 s (first stream maximum 1.60 s, first cycle slower ~2 Hz), then steady: stream peaks at 2.13 2.47 2.80 3.13 3.40 3.73 4.00 4.33 4.67 4.93 s -> 3.3 Hz (FFT 3.28 Hz; 15 fps sampling, +-0.3 Hz). Amplitude from the lateral excursion of the stream just above the foot: peak-to-peak 9-12 px in image x -> half-amplitude ~0.035 D along x_M (range 0.025-0.045 D); the deposited arcs are much wider (fan 0.2 D at 2.2 s, 0.6 D at 4.4 s). Each half-cycle leaves an arc convex toward -y_M (D). The foot stays near (-0.08,0.09) and drifts to (-0.02,0.09) as the cup is righted (feet 2.0 (-0.08,0.10), 2.5 (-0.055,0.11), 3.0 (-0.05,0.10), 3.5 (-0.04,0.10)); hand-fit ellipses until 4.4 s (track quality 0/1), so x is uncertain by ~0.05 D. Stage end chosen at 1.5 + 8/3.3 s so that the Move wobble (phase restarts at every Move) stays continuous into the next stage; with phase 0 at 1.5 s the wobble maxima (+x_M) fall at 2.18 2.48 2.79 3.09 3.39 3.70 4.00 4.30 4.60 4.90 s, within 0.05 s of the observed stream maxima. In the old-solver check the Barista delivers ~70 % of the commanded amplitude at 3.3 Hz (inlet half-amplitude ~0.024 D).

摆动的纹路形成半圆形后向前移动 (subtitle from 4.5 s): wiggling continues while the impact moves forward toward C (strip end in the rectified frame: 3.8 (0.0,0.08), 4.2 (0.02,0.07), 4.4 (0.0,0.05), 4.6 (0.0,0.05), 4.8 (-0.05,0.02), 5.0 (-0.02,0.02); x oscillates +-0.03); spout lowered to ~1-1.5 cm. Arcs fan ~0.6 D wide by 4.4 s, older arcs pushed toward D and wrapping laterally.

VIDEO FREEZE, NOT AN ACTION: clip frames 78-98 (5.20-6.53 s) are one still image (frame 78) with the instructor's dashed guide line; no real time passes and the barista keeps pouring/wiggling without interruption. Encoded as a zero-flow hold so that the converted moves stay aligned with clip time and do not pour extra milk; the kind is kept a pour kind so that the extractor does not count a new pour onset at 6.53 s. For a physically continuous pour use video_targets/layered_heart/stages_realtime.json (this stage removed, later stages shifted by -1.333 s).

video resumes at 6.60 s: still wiggling (stream peaks 6.60 6.87 7.13 s, 3.7 Hz), still creeping forward (6.6 (0.0,0.02), 6.8 (0.0,0.0), 7.0 (-0.01,0.0), 7.2 (-0.02,-0.0), 7.4 (-0.03,-0.01)); spout ~1 cm, thick stream (18-20 px). Pattern is a closed disc ~0.65 D of concentric arcs; wiggle damps out by ~7.5 s.

拉花缸最后小流量拉高收尾 (subtitle from 7.4 s): wiggle stopped, pitcher still low, impact creeps toward D through the arc centre at ~0.1 D/s (7.6 (-0.015,-0.03), 7.8 (-0.014,-0.054), 8.0 (-0.011,-0.071)); stream 16-18 px.

spout raised (stream ~50 px long from 8.2 s, ~2.5 cm), stream thins (14 px at 8.4 s, 12 px at 9.2 s), impact keeps creeping toward D at ~0.1 D/s through the lower half of the disc (8.4 (-0.017,-0.11), 8.8 (-0.03,-0.15), 9.0 (-0.034,-0.184), 9.2 (-0.035,-0.19), 9.4 (-0.025..-0.05,-0.20..-0.22)): the arcs it passes are overwritten by smooth white (the V-region between the lobes); the arcs on both sides are pulled toward the path.

cut: the stream accelerates to ~0.3 D/s and runs to the D edge of the disc (9.53 (-0.012,-0.245), 9.6 (-0.008,-0.27), 9.73 (-0.004,-0.30), 9.8 (0.0,-0.317)), pulling the D edge into the heart tip at (0,-0.33). Spout ~2.5 cm (not 7-9 cm).

stem: thin stream dragged to the D rim at ~0.18 D/s (10.2 (-0.008,-0.381), 10.4 (-0.009,-0.413), 10.6 (0.01,-0.446)); stream 8 px at 10.27 s, 5-6 px at 10.6 s (flow ~0.1); last stream frame 10.67 s, gone 10.73 s. Final stem from (0,-0.33) to (-0.01,-0.43), ~0.02 D wide.
pitcher withdrawn (10.73-11.0 s), cup shown; reference frame (targets/layered_heart.npz) at 11.8 s; scene cut to the next pattern's teaser at 12.27 s.
